title: Bearer Token Leakage to External Servers
description: The app attaches Bearer authentication tokens to all HTTP requests, including requests to external image URLs, allowing token exfiltration via malicious image links.
justification: CVE-2024-26132 affects Element Android (versions 0.91.0-1.6.12), an Android Matrix client application. The vulnerability allows a third-party malicious application to force Element Android to share sensitive files including FCM tokens to unauthorized parties. The core security issue is similar - lack of proper validation before sharing sensitive authentication data with external parties. While CVE-2024-26132 involves file sharing rather than HTTP headers, both vulnerabilities share the fundamental flaw of exposing authentication tokens/credentials to untrusted external entities due to insufficient validation of the recipient.
